asr.full_text: hey guys Rob from my PPC training.com make sure you stop by download our free Google Ads optimization guide and check out our advanced Google Ads training course called Google Ads training academy you won't see the tactics learn here anywhere else there's a link on our website to that and also below this video in the description. And anyways in today's free training we're going to be going through how to actually contact Google support if you have a serious problem or any problem for that fact. Does really matter. Anyways, how can we help? Come up here to contact us and it gives you the option, email support, request, chat, or call. So request chat. You just fill this thing out, hit submit, and you've dropped into the queue for chat. It usually pops up within five minutes and you could talk to Google and resolve your issue. And that's really it. I mean, it's pretty simple. So you're just under Google Partners Help here. And that's it. So request chat chat email support call hopefully i've answered that question for you make sure you subscribe to our channel i know it's a very underwhelming video but that's pretty much it there's not much to it so make sure you subscribe to our channel and i'll see you guys next video
